decks.notes: This mono green aggro deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Leyline of Abundance and Green Sun's Zenith to power out big creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Ashaya, Soul of the Wild. The deck also utilizes creatures like Quirion Ranger and Badgermole Cub to generate additional mana and generate advantage. Using cards like Nature's Rhythm and Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with quickly growing threats and aggressive plays. With a focus on efficient mana ramp and powerful creatures, this deck aims to close out games quickly through sheer force.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, supported by efficient removal and disruption spells. The key strategy is to pressure the opponent with a combination of low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, while utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Thraben Charm for additional damage and control. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah acts as a powerful finisher, backed up by cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, consistent damage output.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Dredge mechanic to fill the graveyard with powerful cards like Arclight Phoenix and Creeping Chill, then quickly bringing them back to the battlefield. It also includes cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting to help dig through the deck and fill the graveyard even faster. By combining graveyard recursion with powerful threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and efficient combo strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing artifacts to quickly build up a board presence and overwhelm the opponent. Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal help accelerate mana while cards like Kappa Cannoneer and Pinnacle Emissary provide threats. Welding Jar and Engineered Explosives offer protection and removal options. Emry, Lurker of the Loch can recur artifacts from the graveyard, increasing the deck's resilience. The inclusion of cards like Tormod's Crypt and Shadowspear disrupt the opponent's strategies, while Metallic Rebuke provides additional control. The goal is to quickly establish dominance through a combination of speed and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting your opponent's mana base with land destruction spells like Cleansing Wildfire and Field of Ruin. This deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Path to Exile and Wrath of the Skies. The inclusion of cards like Solitude and Price of Freedom allows for versatile removal options. With the addition of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion, the deck gains additional value and flexibility in combat situations. Overall, this Boros Ponza deck focuses on disruption and control to outlast and outpace your opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and powerful legendary creatures to create a powerful combo engine. By leveraging cards like Mishra's Bauble, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to generate card advantage and mana acceleration to set up game-winning combos. Cards like Loki, God of Mischief and Oswald Fiddlebender provide additional synergy and utility to the combo pieces. The deck utilizes a mix of control elements like Metallic Rebuke and Portable Hole to disrupt opponents' strategies while assembling its own powerful combos.

The deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive board presence through efficient creatures and disruption, while also leveraging powerful enchantments to generate value and control the game. Utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Solitude for early pressure, along with Goblin Bombardment for additional reach. The deck also includes synergies with Quantum Riddler and Witch Enchanter to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's plans. The mana base is designed to support multiple colors and enable consistent deployment of threats and answers.

The deck revolves around using artifacts and combo pieces to generate value and dig for key cards like Loki, God of Mischief and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. Emry, Lurker of the Loch is used to recur artifacts from the graveyard, while Oswald Fiddlebender helps tutor for specific cards. Urza's Saga is a key land that can generate tokens and find additional artifacts. The deck aims to control the board with counterspells like Metallic Rebuke and disrupt opponents with cards like Pithing Needle and Portable Hole.

This Jeskai Control deck aims to establish board control using a combination of removal spells like Solitude and Wrath of the Skies, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells such as Orim's Chant and Galvanic Discharge. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate card advantage and control the pace of the game. Additionally, the deck includes card draw options like Stock Up and Lórien Revealed to maintain resources and outvalue the opponent in the long run.

The main idea of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Inquisition of Kozilek, and Counterspell, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while controlling the board with Lightning Bolt, Kolaghan's Command, and Snapcaster Mage. Additionally, the deck includes powerful win conditions in Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, Flame of Anor, Subtlety, and Invert Polarity to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disruption and removal to control the opponent's board while using efficient counterspells to protect its own key threats. The deck also includes disruptive creatures like Psychic Frog and Orcish Bowmasters to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to efficiently answer threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage and control over the board. The mana base is designed to support the deck's heavy reliance on blue and black mana sources for its spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Fallaji Archaeologist back from the graveyard for a quick combo finish. The deck also utilizes cards like Faithful Mending and Psychic Frog to control the opponent's board while setting up the combo. Other cards like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize provide disruption and protection for the combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. The deck also utilizes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory to buff its creatures and push for damage. Blood Moon and Ranger-Captain of Eos provide disruption and protection. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm its opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, while using cards like Goblin Bombardment and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for additional damage and control.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and removal spells. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls provide early aggression, while Seasoned Pyromancer generates card advantage. Thraben Charm and Voice of Victory offer versatile removal options, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides a powerful finisher. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Goblin Bombardment and Ranger-Captain of Eos to disrupt opponent's strategies. The mana base is optimized with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the right colors of mana.

This deck focuses on using Song of Creation to draw through the deck quickly, while utilizing cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble to continuously cycle through cards. The presence of Urza's Saga and Mox Amber helps to generate mana quickly to cast spells efficiently. Cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thassa's Oracle help to solidify the win condition once the deck has been thinned out. The deck also includes some disruption and removal spells like Engineered Explosives and Repeal to control the board while setting up for the combo.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to maintain control of the game through countering spells, removing threats, and card advantage. The deck utilizes efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, along with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils, to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, it includes cards like Orim's Chant and Meticulous Archive to further control the pace of the game and maintain card advantage. The goal is to outlast the opponent and eventually win through incremental advantage.
